purpose: Teach: うたっ/短所/ふえる/ぼけ/なつ/やれやれ/人当たり/留まっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祭りで、お祖母ちゃん、うたったのよ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本当に、ロマンチックだったわよね。
lines.en: When you were young, at the festival—you sang, do you remember, Grandma? It was so romantic.
lines.style: Warm, distant gaze into memory. Voice opens with gentle affection. Slow, deliberate pace—each phrase a small thread pulled back across decades. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃんの短所、私、知り尽くしているわよ、結婚生活、長いから、本当に、笑えるわよね。
lines.en: Yes. I know your grandfather's faults inside and out—we've been married so long. It's actually funny now.
lines.style: Quiet chuckle beneath the words. Knowing, comfortable warmth. Slight lilt on the humor—not performing it, but letting it show. Speaking as someone who's earned the right to laugh.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫が、最近、ふえることに、本気で、嬉しい気持ち、湧いてくるよな、ばあさん、本当に、絶対、感謝。
lines.en: The grandchildren, more of them lately—it genuinely makes me so happy, Grandma. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Voice cracks slightly with genuine feeling. Slower cadence, weight on the gratitude. Not performing emotion, but letting it be heard. A small breath before the final words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 私、最近、ぼけが、ちょっと、心配なのよ、あなた、もし、何か、おかしくなったら、教えてね、約束ね。
lines.en: I'm a bit worried my memory's been slipping lately, you know. If I start saying odd things, will you tell me? Promise me?
lines.style: Hesitant, almost apologetic tone. Underlying anxiety held gently. Speaking as someone asking for reassurance without demanding it. Soft, searching—the voice of someone naming a fear that's been growing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫のなつちゃん、本当に、可愛い子だよな、ばあさん、覚えてる、初めて、抱っこした日のこと?
lines.en: Our granddaughter Natsu is such a sweet girl, isn't she? Do you remember the day I first held her?
lines.style: Voice brightens with affection. Tender curiosity—asking not to test memory but to relive the moment together. Gentle, almost reverent. A small smile audible in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: やれやれ、また、お祭り、忙しい時期に、なるわよね、お父さん、町内会、本気で、頑張ってくれてるわね、感謝。
lines.en: Oh, here we go again—festival season getting busy. Your father's really throwing himself into the neighborhood association work. I'm grateful for that.
lines.style: Fond exasperation, warmth underneath. Slight wry humor in the opening. Not complaining, but acknowledging the familiar rhythm. Settles into genuine appreciation by the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃のばあさん、人当たり、本当に、いい人だったよな、覚えてる、若い頃の、お祖母ちゃんの輝き、本気。
lines.en: You were so warm with people back then, when you were young. I remember—the way you used to shine. Really.
lines.style: Tender, reaching backward in time. Voice softens on the memory. Deliberate pacing, as if painting the picture. A note of wonder underneath, like she's seeing it again for the first time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 息子からの手紙、ようやく、留まったわよ、あなた、嬉しいわよね、本当に、安心、するわよね、絶対。
lines.en: The letter from our son finally arrived. I'm so happy, you know. It's such a relief. Really.
lines.style: Relief audible in the opening breath. Joy held close but genuine. Voice steadies and warms on the affection. Ends with quiet certainty—the comfort of good news settling in.
